_how_to_use: One entry per message, key = chat:id (shown on each card's 'open' link; e.g. terra:244943). Fields you may set: kind, tone, stance, targets, topics, summary, notable, tp, ad, mv. Always add a dated note. The original model label stays in the store; the board marks the row ✎ corrected. Example: "terra:244943": {"kind": "criticism", "note": "reviewed by the maintainer 2026-11-26: it is an accusation, not an answer"}
